name: Changchun High-Tech Industry (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Changchun High-Tech Industry (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells biopharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicines products in China. The company offers recombinant human growth hormone injection; recombinant human follicle stimulating hormone for injection; herpes zoster vaccines; live attenuated varicella vaccine; freeze-dried nasal spray live attenuated influenza; xueshuanxinmaining tablet; and yinhuamiyanling tablet. It also develops real estate properties. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Changchun, China.
